uniqueness.builder_read: build.py prepare(), use_pairs/windows selection and grouping logic reviewed. Full dialogue OR disjoint selected pairs is used, which avoids reusing one source answer via both variants. Final outputs were not available yet, so final uniqueness and cross-split checks remain the assembly validator responsibility.
uniqueness.builder_gap: Current build.py deduplicates initial questions, but not normalized assistant answer text. Exact answer texts may repeat across different source IDs unless separately filtered.
uniqueness.interpretation: Repeated answer text across different source IDs does not automatically mean a duplicate example. Very short factual answers can legitimately repeat for distinct questions. Parent plans to deduplicate substantial normalized answers of at least eight words; this report does not verify that final filter.

limitations: AI audit, not human expert assessment.
60 deterministic pairs plus focused suspect screening; does not prove all extracted pairs are independent or factually sound.
Primary-source checks support specific flagged corrections only.
